title: The nephew’s shop and a $1,000 promise
shortTitle: The nephew’s shop and a $1,000 promise
summary: A nephew incurs a $2,000 stock-related loss in reliance on a $1,000 promise.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

What does each version of § 90 permit or require as a remedy? Distinguish enforcing the promised payment from compensating all reliance, and examine the later formulation’s language about limiting relief as justice requires.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
